purpose: Shared verified Free & Cheap records for reuse across NUE surfaces. This is not yet the complete guide dataset.

items.title: Abney Hall Park
items.cost_text: Free local park option; Stockport Council lists 2 free car parks within the park.
items.summary: Parkland and wetland habitat around Abney Hall, with two free car parks listed by Stockport Council.

items.title: Bruntwood Park
items.cost_text: Free park and play option; on-site parking is pay and display.
items.summary: A local park with a fully accessible children's playground and a BMX race track that Stockport Council says is free to use with appropriate protective clothing.
caveats: WATCH THE EXTRAS: the on-site car park is pay and display.

items.title: Hat Works
items.cost_text: General admission is free. Selected factory-floor tours are currently £8.50 adults, £7 concessions and free for under-16s, Leisure Key holders and accompanying carers; online booking fee applies.
items.summary: Free general museum admission, with paid factory-floor tours available on selected dates.
caveats: WATCH THE EXTRAS: factory-floor tours are separate from free general admission and an online booking fee can apply.

items.title: Gatley Carrs
items.cost_text: Free parking is listed by Gatley Carrs Conservation Group.
items.card_detail: Main car-park gate locks at dusk
items.summary: Local nature reserve with maintained walkways, picnic space and free parking listed by the conservation group.
items.access_text: The conservation group describes Gatley Carrs as wheelchair and buggy friendly.
caveats: The main car-park gate is locked at dusk unless by prior arrangement.

items.title: Stockport Museum
items.cost_text: Entry to Stockport Museum is free.
items.summary: A free museum covering Stockport's history, open Tuesday to Saturday 10am to 5pm and Sunday 11am to 4pm; closed Mondays and Bank Holidays.
items.access_text: Stockport Council links to a Detailed Access Guide from AccessAble.
